answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 33106 Country: India Title: I am Fahad Khan a B Tech engineer. I am going to marry soon, may be in the month of October 2011. Question: I am Fahad Khan a B Tech engineer. I am going to marry soon, may be in the month of October 2011. I have three doubts (only three questions): (1) Can I use condom while having sex with my wife? (2) Can I see my wife naked (total open)? (3) Can I kiss her private parts (vagina)? I am asking this question because I have to follow the correct path of Islam. Please help me. Answer ID: 33106 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1105/931/B=1432) (1) Condom is allowed in severe compulsion. It is not lawful if one uses condom to avoid birth. (2) It is allowed but it is against modesty. It is mentioned in hadith that Hadhrat Ayisha (رضى الله عنها) said about the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم): “Never he saw of me nor I saw his”. (3) This is beastly i.e. the act of animals. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
